DIAGNOSIS READY: Major Depressive Disorder, Single Episode, Moderate to Severe, with Psychotic Features.

The clinical presentation of a 4-month history of persistent sadness, significant anhedonia, sleep/appetite disturbance, concentration issues, and mood-congruent auditory hallucinations ("voices telling her she is worthless") strongly supports this diagnosis. The onset of psychosis (7 months ago) preceded the full depressive syndrome, but the current dominant picture is a major depressive episode with secondary psychotic features.
